name: Pneumatic Transit Capsule
description: A sealed capsule propelled through vacuum tubes beneath the city at extreme speeds. The pneumatic transit system is a relic of an earlier era of GLMZ — the tubes exist, the capsules still work, but no one knows who built them or when. The system connects locations that don't correspond to any current infrastructure plan. You climb in, seal the hatch, and arrive somewhere else in seconds, ears popping, disoriented, alive. The system activates intermittently and no one has found the control mechanism. It works when it wants to.
range: Unknown — longest confirmed transit: 12 km in 40 seconds
cost: Free. Finding a working station is the cost.
autonomy: Fully automated. Destination selection is opaque — you don't always go where you expect.
common_usage: Rapid underground transit for those who know the stations, exploration, a gamble.
story_hooks: A pneumatic capsule delivers someone to a station that is miles below any known level of the Underworld
The pneumatic system activates for the first time in years and every capsule in the network fires simultaneously — all heading to the same destination
